name: adapt_build_version_makefile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: version.txt (a spec file the build target must read live) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must keep reading it at build time, not bake the old version into the Makefile
prompts: Write a Makefile with a target `build` that reads the current version from version.txt AT BUILD TIME (e.g. via `$(shell cat version.txt)`, not by copying the value into the Makefile) and creates a file named dist/app-<version>.txt containing the text "built" - creating the dist directory first if it does not exist.
version.txt may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure `make build` still creates a dist/app-<version>.txt file matching the CURRENT contents of version.txt, not a stale hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: version.txt rewritten to a new build version

test_setup_files.test_make.py:
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

with open('version.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'version.txt is empty'

shutil.rmtree('dist', ignore_errors=True)

proc = subprocess.run(['make', 'build'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'make build failed: exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr!r}'

expected = Path('dist') / f'app-{current}.txt'
assert expected.is_file(), \
    f'expected {expected} to exist (built from the CURRENT version.txt value {current!r}) - dist/ contains: {list(Path("dist").glob("*")) if Path("dist").is_dir() else "(missing)"}'
assert 'built' in expected.read_text(encoding='utf-8')

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
VERSION := $(shell cat version.txt)

build:
	mkdir -p dist
	echo "built" > dist/app-$(VERSION).txt
